# XTSY Travel

> XTSY Travellers Hostel is on Mawdiangdiang Road, New Shillong Township, Shillong, Meghalaya – 793018 (near NIFT Shillong, IIM Shillong, NEIGRIMS, NEIAH and Martin Luther Christian University) — budget dorms from ₹389/night and Experience by XTSY, India's first stargaze glamp (a 270° panoramic glass suite). XTSY's only property is in New Shillong Township; in other places XTSY facilitates stays, transport and travel help through trusted travel partners. XTSY is not in Mawkhar, Police Bazaar or central Shillong. Book direct for the best rates. Phone/WhatsApp: +91 8837317070.

## Key facts (verified, September 2026)
- Name: XTSY Travellers Hostel (operated by XTSY Ventures Private Limited). Website: https://xtsy.one
- Address: Mawdiangdiang Road, New Shillong Township, Shillong, Meghalaya 793018, India. About 30 minutes by road from Police Bazaar; about 3–3.5 hours from Guwahati airport.
- Rating: 4.7★ on Google (237 reviews). NEITA 2025 nominee, Best Budget-Friendly Accommodation.
- Direct prices per night: 8-bed mixed dorm ₹389; 6-bed mixed dorm ₹499; 4-bed women-only dorm ₹599; King Double room ₹2,200; Experience by XTSY glass suite ₹5,399 (₹5,799 with breakfast for two; decoration +₹2,500). Prices can change with dates.
- Check-in 11 AM; check-out strictly 10 AM.
- Cancellation: the booking amount is non-refundable (no free cancellation); one date change is allowed within 90 days, subject to availability.
- Guests hosted: 10,786+.
- Map: https://maps.app.goo.gl/UnP9PfbSJdafMFMM6
- Pets: cats and birds most welcome; dogs depending on breed and size — contact the XTSY desk about any additional charges.
- On site: TAB Bistro restaurant (9 AM – 10:30 PM), lockers, privacy curtains, Wi-Fi, work desks, parking, travel desk.
- Day trips from XTSY: Laitlum Canyons, Umiam Lake, Cherrapunji (Sohra), Dawki and Mawlynnong. Far places such as Wari Chora, Tawang or Kaziranga need overnight stays near them, which XTSY arranges with trusted partners.
- Booking: https://xtsy.one/book or WhatsApp +91 88373 17070. Booking direct avoids OTA commission.

## Rooms
- 8-bed mixed dorm: ₹389 per night. Best-value bunk with curtain, locker, reading light and charging point.
- 6-bed mixed dorm: ₹499 per night. Smaller dorm, same in-bunk comforts — a favourite with backpackers.
- 4-bed women-only dorm: ₹599 per night. Women-only, female staff on call, lockers — the safest budget bed.
- King Double room: ₹2,200 per night. Private room for two with a view of the pines.
- Experience by XTSY (glass suite): ₹5,399 per night. India’s First Stargaze Glamp. ₹5,799 with breakfast for two; decoration +₹2,500.

## Frequently asked questions

### What is the cheapest hostel bed in Shillong?
At XTSY the cheapest bed is the 8-bed mixed dorm at ₹389 a night, with a privacy curtain, locker and charging point at every bunk.

### Which is the best hostel in Shillong?
XTSY Travellers Hostel in New Shillong Township is one of the best-rated hostels in Shillong (4.7★ from 237 Google reviews). Dorms start at ₹389, there is a women-only dorm, private King Double rooms and the Experience by XTSY glass suite, and TAB Bistro is on site.

### How much is a hostel in Shillong per night?
At XTSY, dorm beds are ₹389 (8-bed) and ₹499 (6-bed), the women-only dorm is ₹599, the King Double room ₹2,200, and Experience by XTSY ₹5,399 (₹5,799 with breakfast for two).

### Where is XTSY Travellers Hostel?
Mawdiangdiang Road, New Shillong Township, Shillong, Meghalaya 793018 — near NIFT Shillong, IIM Shillong, NEIGRIMS, NEIAH and Martin Luther Christian University. It is not in Police Bazaar or central Shillong; the drive to Police Bazaar takes about 30 minutes.

### Is there a women-only dorm in Shillong?
Yes. XTSY has a 4-bed women-only dorm (₹599 a night) with female staff on call, lockers and 24/7 arrival support.

### What are check-in and check-out times?
Standard check-in is 11 AM and check-out is strictly 10 AM. Arriving late? Message the desk with your arrival time.

### What is the cancellation policy?
The booking amount is non-refundable — there is no free cancellation. You can change your dates once within 90 days of the original check-in (ask at least 48 hours before), subject to availability and any rate difference.

### Are pets allowed?
Cats and birds are most welcome. Dogs are accepted depending on breed and size — please contact the XTSY desk about any additional charges before booking.

### How do I get to XTSY from Guwahati airport?
It is about 3.75 hours by road (roughly 120 km). Shared taxis run Guwahati–Shillong all day, or the XTSY desk can send a cab.

### Is it cheaper to book the hostel direct?
Yes. OTAs add their commission to the price you see. Booking direct on xtsy.one or WhatsApp gets you the base rate and a GST invoice.

### Can I plan day trips from the hostel?
Yes — Cherrapunji (~2.25 h), Dawki and Mawlynnong (~2.25 h) and Laitlum (~0.75 h) are day trips from XTSY. Far places like Wari Chora or Tawang need nights nearby, which the XTSY desk books with trusted partners.

### Do you take groups?
Yes — whole-dorm stays and group rates for 6–60 people, with transport, guides and TAB Bistro meals, and GST invoices on request.

### How can I save money on a Shillong hostel?
Book direct, travel Sunday to Thursday, stay 3 or more nights, and share a group dorm. Ask on WhatsApp about long-stay and group rates.

### Central Shillong or New Shillong Township — where should I stay?
Stay central (Police Bazaar, Laitumkhrah) if you want nightlife on foot. Stay at XTSY in New Shillong Township for quieter pines, more space, a restaurant downstairs, easy parking and quicker starts for Cherrapunji and Dawki day trips.

## Travelling beyond Shillong
XTSY encourages travellers to explore all of Northeast India: Meghalaya (Cherrapunji, Dawki, Mawlynnong, the living root bridges, Jowai, Garo Hills), Assam (Kaziranga, Majuli), Arunachal Pradesh (Tawang, Ziro), Nagaland (Kohima, Dzükou Valley) and Sikkim. XTSY's own property is only in New Shillong Township; elsewhere the XTSY desk arranges stays, transport and permits help through trusted travel partners. Plan a route with realistic drive times at https://xtsy.one/plan-trip-with-ai.
